name: Enshrouded
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The voxel survival action RPG for up to 16 players. Installs the Windows dedicated server with SteamCMD, runs it under Wine and keeps it updated.
startup: python3 .raptor-groups.py || exit 1; rm -f logs/enshrouded_server.log; mkdir -p logs; touch logs/enshrouded_server.log; set -m; wine ./enshrouded_server.exe > logs/wine.log 2>&1 & pid=$!; trap "kill -INT $pid" INT TERM; tail -n +1 -F logs/enshrouded_server.log --pid=$pid & rc=0; while kill -0 $pid 2>/dev/null; do wait $pid; rc=$?; done; [ "$rc" = 0 ] || { echo "The server stopped with code $rc. Wine's last lines:"; grep -v "Crypto API failed" logs/wine.log | tail -n 20; exit $rc; }

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Enshrouded. Installs or updates the dedicated server (Steam app 2278520) with
# SteamCMD, signed in anonymously. Saves and the
# settings the Panel doesn't own are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
export HOME=/mnt/server
app="${SRCDS_APPID:-2278520}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

# SteamCMD stays in the server folder, so the server can update itself at start.
if [ ! -x steamcmd/steamcmd.sh ]; then
    echo "Downloading SteamCMD"
    mkdir -p steamcmd
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz | tar -xz -C steamcmd
fi
mkdir -p steamapps
args=(+@sSteamCmdForcePlatformType windows +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login anonymous +app_update "$app")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAID:-}" ] || args+=(-beta "$SRCDS_BETAID")
[ -z "${SRCDS_BETAPASS:-}" ] || args+=(-betapassword "$SRCDS_BETAPASS")
[ "${VALIDATE:-0}" != 1 ] || args+=(validate)
# SteamCMD often fails once for no lasting reason (Missing configuration,
# state 0x202 or 0x602 after it updates itself): try again, up to 5 times.
for try in 1 2 3 4 5; do
    ./steamcmd/steamcmd.sh "${args[@]}" +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log || true
    grep -aq "Success! App '$app'" /tmp/steamcmd.log && break
    err=$(grep -aE '^(ERROR|Error)!' /tmp/steamcmd.log | tail -n 1) || true
    case "$err" in
    *"No subscription"*) fail "Steam won't give this game to an anonymous account, so it can't be installed." ;;
    *"Invalid Password"* | *"Invalid beta"*) fail "Steam refused the beta branch or its password. Check Beta branch and Beta password, then reinstall." ;;
    esac
    [ "$try" = 5 ] && fail "SteamCMD failed 5 times (${err:-no error given}). If it mentions 0x202, the server may be out of disk space. Reinstall to try again."
    echo "SteamCMD failed; trying again ($((try + 1)) of 5)."
    sleep 5
done
# Steam's client library, where the game looks for it.
mkdir -p .steam/sdk32 .steam/sdk64
cp -f steamcmd/linux32/steamclient.so .steam/sdk32/
cp -f steamcmd/linux64/steamclient.so .steam/sdk64/
build=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*"buildid"[[:space:]]*"\([0-9]*\)".*/\1/p' "steamapps/appmanifest_$app.acf" | head -n 1)

# Enshrouded reads enshrouded_server.json. Write one when there's none, with
# the four player groups whose passwords the Panel sets.
cfg=enshrouded_server.json
group() {
    jq -n --arg n "$1" --argjson all "$2" --argjson kick "$3" --argjson slots "$4" \
        '{name: $n, password: "", canKickBan: $kick, canAccessInventories: $all, canEditWorld: $all, canEditBase: $all, canExtendBase: $all, reservedSlots: $slots}'
}
groups=$(jq -s . <(group Admin true true 0) <(group Friend true false 1) <(group Guest false false 0) <(group Visitor false false 0))
if [ ! -f "$cfg" ]; then
    jq -n --argjson g "$groups" '{name: "An Enshrouded server", saveDirectory: "./savegame", logDirectory: "./logs",
        ip: "0.0.0.0", queryPort: 15637, slotCount: 16, gameSettingsPreset: "Default", userGroups: $g}' > "$cfg"
    echo "Made enshrouded_server.json."
elif ! jq -e '.userGroups | length >= 4' "$cfg" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    # A config from before player groups: add them, keeping everything else.
    jq --argjson g "$groups" '.userGroups = $g | del(.password, .gamePort)' "$cfg" > "$cfg.new" && mv "$cfg.new" "$cfg"
    echo "Added the player groups to enshrouded_server.json."
fi
mkdir -p savegame logs
# Enshrouded refuses a config where two groups share a password or more than
# one group has none. The Panel writes the passwords at every start; this runs
# after it: the most trusted group without a password stays open to anyone
# (lower ones would add nothing), the others get a random password nobody
# knows, and two groups with the same password stop the start with a message.
cat > .raptor-groups.py <<'EOF'
import json, secrets, sys
path = "enshrouded_server.json"
cfg = json.load(open(path))
groups = cfg.get("userGroups", [])
set_pw = [g["password"] for g in groups if g.get("password")]
if len(set_pw) != len(set(set_pw)):
    print("Two player groups have the same password. Give each group its own password, then start again.")
    sys.exit(1)
open_group = None
for g in groups:
    if not g.get("password"):
        if open_group is None:
            open_group = g.get("name")
        else:
            g["password"] = "closed-" + secrets.token_hex(12)
with open(path, "w") as f:
    json.dump(cfg, f, indent=2)
if open_group:
    print(f"Anyone can join as {open_group}: that group has no password.")
EOF
echo "Installed Enshrouded build ${build:-unknown}${SRCDS_BETAID:+ from the $SRCDS_BETAID branch}."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server list.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: Players joining with it can do everything, kicking and banning included. Not only digits.

variables.name: Friend password
variables.description: Players joining with it can build and use chests. Empty lets anyone join as a friend. Only the most trusted group without a password is open.

variables.name: Guest password
variables.description: Players joining with it can play but not build or open chests. Empty lets anyone join as a guest. Only the most trusted group without a password is open.

variables.name: Visitor password
variables.description: Players joining with it can only look around. Empty lets anyone join as a visitor. Only the most trusted group without a password is open.

variables.name: Auto update
variables.description: Update the game from Steam every time the server starts.

variables.name: Beta branch
variables.description: The Steam beta branch to install, or empty for the normal release. Reinstall after changing it.

variables.name: Beta password
variables.description: The password of a private beta branch, if it has one.

variables.name: Steam app ID
variables.description: The dedicated server's Steam app ID, which SteamCMD installs.

variables.name: Windows install
variables.description: Install the Windows version of the server, which runs under Wine.

variables.name: Wine debug
variables.description: What Wine logs; -all keeps its messages out of the console.
